verdict.rationale: Running a compliance platform headlessly or in CI, through a CLI, API tokens, or a CI integration, is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence documents no such capability. The MCP server only lets an interactive AI assistant act inside a workspace. Built-in monitors and automated evidence collection are internal automation, not headless or CI execution, so they are adjacent features at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
